meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码库交给多名漏洞猎手和验证工程师并行审查,找出真正可利用的缺陷并定级。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布前想确认代码里没有被忽视的可利用漏洞。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to confirm exploitable flaws before shipping.

howto.what: 会组建一支 5 人团队(3 名漏洞猎手 + 2 名 PoC 工程师)并行审计代码库,验证漏洞是否真能被利用,按实际可利用性定级,并输出含结论、发现表、降级项和残余风险的安全报告。
howto.when: 当你说出 “security-research”“security review” 等关键词,或要求做发布前安全检查、威胁模型验证、代码审计时接管;需已开启 team 模式并在主会话中。

say.text: 对当前分支的改动做一次安全审计
say.note: 会组队并行审查并尝试验证可利用性

say.text: 检查这个仓库有哪些可被利用的漏洞
say.note: 输出带 PoC、CWE 与定级的报告

say.text: 对这次发布候选版本做发布前安全检查

howto.what_en: Spins up a 5-member team (3 vulnerability hunters + 2 PoC engineers) to audit a codebase in parallel, prove or falsify exploitability, score severity by real exploitability, and produce a report with a verdict, findings table, downgraded items, and residual risk.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like "security-research" or "security review", or when you ask for a pre-release security check, threat model validation, or code audit. Requires team mode enabled and a main session.

say_en.text: Audit the changes on my current branch for security issues
say_en.note: Runs a parallel team review and tries to verify exploitability

say_en.text: Find exploitable vulnerabilities in this repository
say_en.note: Reports PoCs, CWEs and severity ratings
